title: 4410 ARC Lightning's INTO THE DEEP Worlds/States/Q2 Robot (V2)
author: Raahil Parikh
description: This is 4410 ARC Lightning's robot for the INTO THE DEEP competition season. It has a pivoting extending arm with a differential wrist at the end of the arm connecting to our claw. It also features a 2-speed shifting gearbox for the linear slides that allows this robot to easily achieve a Level 3 Ascent in <8 seconds.
